en: A vintage black-and-white photograph showing a lively beach scene. Many people, including families and children, are sunbathing, playing, or walking along the sandy beach. Dunes and grassy vegetation are visible in the foreground, with a group of children sitting on the slope. The beach extends into the distance, with a pier or breakwater and some structures further down the coast. A flag is visible near a white building in the background, and the overall style and clothing of the beachgoers suggest the mid-20th century.
